entries.note: Miwa 2011 (PMID 21657270) resolves; quote verbatim in abstract. Field fix: model_filed should be true, FDA 214846 PharmR p.32 summarises the castrated-cynomolgus LH study TAK-385-00095 (0.1-3 mg/kg, LH down 48 h at 3 mg/kg).
Nakata 2014 (PMID 24333551, epub 2013-12-18) resolves; quote verbatim. FDA PharmR p.32 study TAK-385-00103 confirms model_filed true.

MacLean 2015 (PMID 26502357) resolves; quote verbatim. Europe PMC has no full-text XML for PMC4667159, so the macaque citation stays unverified as the drafter said. Healthy men count for engagement. Field fix: model_filed true (TAK-385-00095 filed).
Same MacLean 2015 source; quote verbatim. Nakata abstract states prostate weight to castrate levels in male knock-in mice; castrate testosterone in men is a direction-only match.
Untested opening entry; no exposure target in Miwa 2011. Field fix: model_filed true (FDA PharmR p.32).
FDA PharmR confirms 100 mg/kg BID effective and 30 mg/kg no-effect in female knock-in mice with no TK; a mg/kg dose without exposure is not a target. Untested stands.

FDA 214846 PharmR (posted 2021) quote verbatim; NOAEL 15 mg/kg = 26.2x for liver and menses cessation, 50 mg/kg (99x) liver toxicity. Margin stated and held at 40 mg in endometriosis (Osuga 2021, SPIRIT): decision 16 same. Source is the fibroid NDA; consider imported_from.
Yselty EPAR (EMA/266814/2022, 22 Apr 2022) p.18 states the monkey Clast >~20 ug/mL threshold and p.~60 the 100% E2 <20 pg/mL at 200 mg; verbatim. Human Clast not stated, so direction_only is right.

EPAR quote verbatim (absolute margin <1, ~3-fold free drug). Patients reached 200 mg with slight AST/ALT excess, no block. Decision 16 has no row for a stated margin <1 that patients nevertheless tolerated; same + partial is defensible, raised as a rule question.
Untested on the monkey track: LH/E2/menses are PD surrogates, no disease readout. Consistent only if the mouse track is scored the same way (see efficacy 4). Field fix: model_filed true.
Nakata 2014 quote verbatim; the paper names endometriosis as an indication but tests uterine weight only. Opening untested entry is right.

Kim 2015 (PMID 26321528) resolves; quote verbatim. SKI2670 is a non-member proxy, product_in_model false. Tezuka 2023 uses renal-subcapsular autotransplantation; Kim's implant site is not stated in the abstract, pooling as one rat autotransplant system is reasonable.

entries.rule: CHECKER_BRIEF_v3 §3 bullet 1 (pairing on conditions the model never tested); DRAFTER_BRIEF_v3 efficacy definition
entries.note: Osuga 2021 quote verbatim (epub 2020-09-12, NCT01458301 no results). The knock-in mouse never tested lesions or pain; uterine atrophy is the same oestrogen-deprivation surrogate as the monkey E2/menses readout the drafter left untested. Score both tracks alike; if the mouse stays same, the monkey must be same too.
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4: efficacy scores the trial primary as the model predicted; the knock-in mouse predicted uterine atrophy (a PD surrogate), never pain or lesions. Decision 8: one rule per track, so the mouse is untested like the monkey.

entries.note: Donnez 2020 (PMID 32505383) quote verbatim; NCT02778399 results posted 2022-07-21 confirmed; EPAR p.18 rat sentence verbatim; Tezuka 2023 (PMID 37186405, received 2023-01-31) cyst-volume quote verbatim. Prospective status rests on an unknown run date (rule question).

Osuga 2021 clause verbatim; FDA PharmR p.32 bone sentence verbatim, OVX control also null. Contra holds on a literal reading (species could show it, model data said none) but an insensitive null is a rule question. Year 2021 depends on Nakata 2014 full text not reporting bone; not checked (paywalled).
FDA PharmR 39-week monkey summary has no bone endpoint (grep: bone only as marrow/micronucleus); menses-cessation and uterine-atrophy predictions matched. Contra on BMD silence supported.

Donnez 2020 BMD sentence verbatim. EPAR nonclinical (pp.17-30) silent on bone; liver finding stated (p.~27 'increase in serum ALT and glutamate dehydrogenase'); the judgement's 'serum liver enzyme activity' sentence was not found verbatim, near only. Contra + partial supported.

Yselty EPAR EMA/266814/2022 p.18 verbatim ('supressed' sic); rat Ki 274 nM p.17. Opening untested entry on a new rat track; the rat PD study's run date is not public (existing rule question 4 applies). model_filed true is right for an MAA primary-pharmacology study.

EPAR p.52 quote verbatim (clinical primary pharmacology); rat side p.18 verbatim. Pairing is the drafter's: E2 fell dose-dependently in rat and in women, no rat threshold quoted, so direction_only. A filed primary-pharmacology study, not post-hoc; 2022 is the first document carrying both sides.

entries.rule: RQ 93 (dose = target reached); decision 7 dating; decision 11 magnitude
entries.note: Quote verbatim (en-dashes normalised). Donnez 2024 full text (PMC11144970, open) states: 'E2 levels were maintained within a therapeutic range (between 20 and 60 pg/ml) ... in patients who received 75 mg linzagolix daily' (Fig. 2). Target reached prospectively at 75 mg: same 2024, direction_only (trial band 20-60 vs model 20-50; medians only in the figure).
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 case 2: the model's E2 window was reached at 75 mg (Donnez 2024, 20-60 vs 20-50 pg/mL) and the drug worked (this track's efficacy entry 7, same/partial). Prospective under decision 10; no decision 16 block. Same, 2024.

entries.note: Pohl 2022 (PMC9306723) abstract and discussion verbatim (dashes normalised); received 2021-04-13, accepted 2021-11-21, epub 2022-01-13. Paper states its goal was phase 3 dose selection and that 75 mg was the selected phase 3 dose (NCT03992846). Decision 8 admits in-silico systems; the FLT3 exposure-response exclusion is a rule question, not a rule.

ObsEva topline 2022-01-06 precedes epub 2022-01-13 by 7 days, but the manuscript was received 2021-04-13 (before primary completion 2021-10-18) and the 75 mg arm fixed 2019-06-13; decision 10 ('post-dates and motivated by') is not met, so same + partial stands (DYS 44.0% vs 23.5%, NMPP p=0.279; model gave >95% for both). Donnez 2024 cites Pohl 2022 for PK/PD only and credits the dose to EDELWEISS 1, so comparison_stated false holds. EPAR 2022 has no EDELWEISS 3 data; 2024 dating right.

Flores 2025 (PMID 39393571, epub 2024-10-10, print 2025-02-01) quote verbatim in abstract. Cetrorelix only, product_in_model false; PR-stratified response to GnRH antagonism never tested in patients, so untested 2024 at patient level is right. Note the abstract also reports high-PR lesions responding 21-fold more completely to cetrorelix, so the model's stratification runs both ways.

entries.rule: safety definition (stated harm prediction held); decision 7 dating; decision 11 magnitude
entries.note: Model: 75-125 mg keeps 24-week LS BMD loss within the -1.6% target (50 mg -0.09%, 100 mg -1.30%, abstract verbatim). Donnez 2024 full text: 'BMD loss was not clinically meaningful (<1% from baseline for the lumbar spine, femoral neck, and total hip at 24 weeks)'; abstract gives <1% in both arms. Prospective at 75 mg alone: same 2024; magnitude within_2x on LS BMD (adjudicator's call).
entries.adjudication_note: Decision 4 safety: the model's stated prediction (24-week LS BMD loss within -1.6% at 75-125 mg) held in EDELWEISS 3 (<1% at 75 mg, Donnez 2024). Prospective under decision 10; decision 16 counts no window failure. Same, 2024.

field_corrections: model_filed: null -> true on engagement 1, engagement 3, dose 1, efficacy 1 (cyno-monkey-hpg): FDA 214846 PharmR p.32 summarises study TAK-385-00095, single oral 0.1-3 mg/kg in nine castrated cynomolgus monkeys, LH suppressed to 48 h at 3 mg/kg.

Context note: 'barely rat GnRHR' is true of relugolix (rat IC50 2900 nM, FDA PharmR p.3) but not linzagolix, which suppressed LH in male rats and E2 in pro-oestrus female rats (EPAR p.18) and worked in the rat endometriosis model.

missing: Patient-derived xenograft ('murine avatar') of human endometrioma lesions in NOD/SCID mice dosed with the GnRH antagonist cetrorelix: low-PR lesions respond more to GnRH antagonism than to MPA (F S Sci 2025, PMID 39393571, doi 10.1016/j.xfss.2024.10.004). A patient-level track for this mechanism with a non-member peptide sibling (product_in_model false, modality outside the tile); no patient comparison yet, so untested, but it is a model compared-in-principle with patients and should be listed.

Rat autotransplant track has no dose entry although Tezuka 2023 (PMID 37186405) states a model exposure target: 'The effective concentration of linzagolix, calculated as the free form of the last-observed drug concentration, was ~1 umol/L in endometriosis model rats.' Comparable to human free exposure at 200 mg (EPAR gives ~3-fold free-drug margin); at least an untested opening entry, possibly same.

Knock-in mouse reversibility prediction (Nakata 2014: gonadal function recovered within 14 days of withdrawal) matched by faster menses return on relugolix vs leuprorelin (Osuga 2022, PMID 34895700). A held prediction on the hgnrhr-knockin-mouse track; does not lift the bone contra but belongs in the record.

Nothing missed on failures: no endometriosis press-release or EMA failure for relugolix or linzagolix (EDELWEISS 2 termination already noted); opigolix/ASP1707 has no preclinical model on PubMed or Europe PMC (16 hits, all clinical or reviews), confirming the drafter's 'no public model'.
rule_questions: Efficacy from PD-only models: can a model with no disease readout (knock-in mouse uterine weight; monkey E2/menses) score efficacy against a pain primary endpoint, or is that scoring the oestrogen-deprivation hypothesis rather than the model? The draft scores the mouse same and the monkey untested on identical evidence; the rules decide neither.

Insensitive null as a prediction: the mouse measured bone density and found no change, but its OVX positive control also showed none (4 weeks). Is that a stated prediction of no harm (contra when patients lost BMD) or an inadmissible comparison (untested)?

Decision 16 gap: the model stated an absolute liver margin <1 at the clinical exposure (EPAR), yet patients were dosed to 200 mg with only slight LFT excess. Is dose same with source_calls_it partial/over_predicted, or contra with magnitude opposite for a misplaced margin in the conservative direction?

Retrodiction with an unknown run date: the linzagolix rat study is in the MAA primary-PD package (EPAR 2022) and was published in 2023, after the 2018 phase 2b readout; its run date is not public. Default prospective (same) or retro?

Must every track open in every cell? The rat track appears only in efficacy and the tox track only in dose/safety; lint accepts this, the brief's 'each cell opens at model_first_use_year' is ambiguous.
